race.description: Tabtouch Better Your Bet Mdn Hcp
race.comment: OPAL NERO (11) is the one to beat despite plain finishing positions, because the last two runs at Northam both came with the significant caveat of covering ground throughout and he now strikes a softer assignment fourth-up. His long maiden record and 1500m profile prevent overconfidence, but the set-up is clearly more suitable. DANCING SPIRIT (6) also comes through provincial company and was only beaten just under four lengths at Geraldton when respected in an open market, although her previous 1500m attempts leave a query. LAST SHOUT (3) has the most appealing recent closing effort, charging home two back before being steadied last time, and is fit enough to improve third-up. MONEY MANZIEL (4) is the unknown runner, with two Belmont Park trials and a strong jockey-trainer profile giving him genuine place-and-upside appeal on debut. YALDA NIGHT (2) can resume on a positive note.
